text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/safe-net v1.3.2 -> prod canary (10%) at 1762501234. Release notes: https://go.redwood/safe-net-1.3.2. Rollout window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Backout runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/deploy-backout-v2

sam: Noted. I'll watch logs for the first 5m and keep the revert command ready. Pin fallback artifact v1.3.1 is staged.

nina: Canary targets: payments-api + conv-service. If error rate > 2% or p95 regresses by +200ms across canary, we abort and revert route.

maria: How do we trigger a revert manually? Want the exact command to paste.

sam: Two ways:
- Automated: `deploy-bot revert --stage=prod --to=1.3.1`
- Manual k8s: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/conv conv=image:v1.3.1`
Runbook section 3 has the full escape-hatch script and post-revert smoke steps.

leo: I'm on pager for the window. If I don't ack within 2m of page, page @oncall-ops.

oncall-ops: Confirmed. We'll watch SLOs and latency panels (prod/conv p95, errors, throughput). Traffic plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m if healthy.

nina: Also call out: disable caching warmup on revert — cache keys changed in this release. See note in runbook step 4.

sam: Copy. My checklist: 1) Collect logs to /ops/logs/rolling/1762501234 2) Abort/revert if >2% errors or p95 +200ms 3) After revert, run smoke /smoke-tests/prod/basic and validate transactions.

deploy-bot: Health update @channel — canary nodes 3/3 up. No errors in first 60s. Metrics: p95=120ms, errors=0.4%. Proceeding to 25% at +5m.

maria: If we want to avoid full rollback, can we traffic-split to old model variant instead? That would be lower blast radius.

sam: Yes. Traffic pin commands: `deploy-bot traffic-split --service=conv --to=stable:90,canary:10`
To pin fully to stable: `deploy-bot traffic-split --service=conv --to=stable:100`

leo: If I trigger a revert I'll post EXACTLY: "REVERTING NOW" then execute step 1-4 from runbook.

oncall-ops: Noted. We've copied rollback script to /home/oncall/rollback_scripts/conv_revert.sh and given exec perms. Pager chain ready.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 1762501605. No anomalies detected in the window. Closing window in 30m. :tada:

sam: Great. Marking runbook checklist as complete in the ticket. If any anomalies show up, reopen this thread and we'll follow revert steps.
